data.title: Senior Content Strategist - Freelance
data.description: <div>At AKQA (part of WPP) we believe in the imaginative application of art and science to create beautiful ideas, products and services. With an entrepreneurial and collaborative approach, we design adaptive digital services and applications that capture the imagination, delivering impressive returns for our clients.</div> <div><br>Content strategists at AKQA are curious thinkers who want to investigate, understand, and organize to create a better future, with a specific focus on the content that powers our clients' experiences. To us, content is more than words on a screen; it is the story and information that drives our clients' brands and products forward.<br><br>In this role, the Freelance Senior Content Strategist will support end-to-end content experience strategy for a flagship digital platform and connected product ecosystem for one of the most recognized and trusted names in financial services, a brand with deep roots in helping people plan, protect, and secure their futures. Responsibilities span auditing current experiences, identifying gaps and opportunities, defining an ideal-state vision, and developing a pragmatic roadmap to get there. The Strategist will work closely with senior client stakeholders and an integrated AKQA team to formulate and deliver smart, tailored content frameworks, recommendations, and systems that serve our client's needs across digital products and platforms.<br><br></div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>ROLE REQUIREMENTS</div> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in content strategy for digital products, apps, and web platforms, with a portfolio that demonstrates structured thinking and measurable outcomes on complex, high-visibility consumer experiences</li> <li>Strong writing and editing skills, with the ability to define voice, tone, messaging hierarchies, and editorial guidelines across product and marketing surfaces</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to analyze user, client, and business needs and develop relevant content strategies, frameworks, and taxonomies that measurably improve outcomes</li> <li>Comfort consuming large quantities of research and data, including behavioral, consumer, industry, and academic sources, to inform perspectives, set KPIs, and partner on measurement</li> <li>Experience driving content for high-traffic digital surfaces, including information architecture, navigation, personalization, SEO, accessibility, experimentation, and content operations</li> <li>Proven success working cross-functionally with strategists, product managers, UX designers, copywriters, creatives, engineering, and analytics teams</li> <li>Strong presentation skills, with the ability to craft persuasive narratives and present confidently to senior clients and internal leadership</li> <li>Knowledge of contemporary practice across digital product development, including agile delivery, content governance, and operational frameworks</li> <li>Ability to take responsibility for on-time deliverables and expertly crafted perspectives within an accelerated timeline</li> </ul> <div><br><br>QUALITIES AND CHARACTERISTICS</div> <ul> <li>Undaunted by the unknown; ambiguity sparks your curiosity and accelerates your learning</li> <li>A love of hard problems and a drive to inspire new ways of thinking across teams and stakeholders</li> <li>A passion for transforming large amounts of disorganized information into clarity through structure, rigor, and systems</li> <li>Deep affinity for the end user, with empathy that translates into usable, valuable content experiences</li> <li>Extreme attention to detail coupled with the ability to zoom out to a compelling strategic narrative</li> <li>Phenomenal communication skills and the ability to partner with senior clients and executive stakeholders</li> <li>8+ years working across digital experience, brand experience, customer experience, or communications; an intersection of more than one is ideal; experience with financial services, membership and loyalty programs, or mobile app ecosystems is a plus</li> <li>Self-directed and proactive; comfortable operating independently in a fast-paced, high-visibility environment</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Location &amp; data.title: Community Web Manager
data.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

About the Team:

The ServiceNow Community Platform team manages one of ServiceNow's largest customer-facing digital experiences. The Community serves customers, developers, partners, user groups, product teams, and advocates through forums, product hubs, events, learning resources, and peer-to-peer engagement experiences. 

We are looking for a Community Web Manager to lead publishing operations and content management across the ServiceNow Community platform. This role is responsible for ensuring content is accurate, timely, discoverable, and aligned with the needs of business stakeholders and customers. 

What You Will Do:

Own Community Publishing Operations:

  • Execute and manage website updates across the ServiceNow Community platform. 

  • Manage staging, quality assurance, and production deployment processes. 

  • Design, build, and deploy landing pages using Khoros templates. 

  • Manage page layouts, components, asset placement, and responsive design. 

  • Manage external Community properties, like the ServiceNow Community YouTube channel, podcast publishing via Omny, and video publishing on Brightcove. 

Manage Community Platform Configuration:

  • Configure site navigation, redirects, content placement, tagging, labels, permissions, and visibility settings. 

  • Support role-based access controls and community governance requirements. 

  • Partner with engineering and product to identify publishing workflow improvements, submit feature requests, and resolve publishing issues. 

  • Collaborate with UX design and brand teams on page layouts, components, design implementation, and brand compliance. 

Support Product Hubs and Community Experiences: 

  • Build and maintain product hub experiences using established templates and content frameworks. 

  • Coordinate content migrations, launches, and updates with business stakeholders. 

  • Ensure content is organized and presented consistently across the platform. 

Partner with Stakeholders: 

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for Community publishing and content management requests. 

  • Consult with product marketing, customer marketing, events, advocacy, and enablement teams on content strategy and site best practices. 

  • Translate business requirements into scalable web experiences. 

  • Manage multiple projects and competing priorities while maintaining service-level expectations.

Enable Self-Service Publishing: 

  • Train stakeholders on community tools, publishing processes, and governance standards. 

  • Develop documentation, reference materials, and training resources. 

  • Support content owners in maintaining their sections of the Community platform. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications: 

  • 7+ years of experience in web publishing, web content management, digital operations, community management, or related field. 

  • Experience working within a CMS, digital experience platform, or online community platform. 

  • Strong understanding of content governance, publishing workflows, and quality assurance practices. 

  • Experience managing multiple stakeholder requests and priorities. 

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills. 

  • Strong project management and organizational skills. 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience managing publishing workflows in community platforms (Khoros, Gainsight, Higher Logic, etc.)" 

  • Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JSON-based content configuration, Adobe Experience Cloud (AEM, Adobe Target, etc), Adobe Photoshop, redirects, navigation management, and CMS administration. 

  • Experience supporting enterprise-scale customer-facing digital properties. 

  • Experience designing and delivering stakeholder training and enablement. 

  • Experience utilizing AI tools to streamline publishing workflows, content optimization, or stakeholder enablement. 

Key Competencies:

  • Web Publishing & Content Operations 

  • Digital Experience Management 

  • Stakeholder Management 

  • Content Governance 

  • Platform Administration 

  • Quality Assurance 

  • Training & Enablement 

  • Project Coordination 

Additional Information

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

Equal Opportunity Employer

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity,  veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.  

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance. 

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

data.summary: The Community Web Manager leads publishing operations and content management across the ServiceNow Community platform. Responsibilities include managing website updates and deployments, configuring platform features, building product hub experiences, coordinating content migrations and launches, supporting stakeholders, and developing self-service publishing training and documentation.

data.title: Senior Manager, Brand Marketing
data.description:
About CertifyOS

CertifyOS is building the data infrastructure that powers modern healthcare.

Today, healthcare organizations rely on fragmented and outdated provider data. This creates unnecessary administrative work, regulatory risk, and higher costs across the system. We’re solving that problem.

Our API-first platform automates provider licensing, enrollment, credentialing, and network monitoring by connecting directly to hundreds of primary data sources. We help healthcare organizations maintain accurate, compliant, and reliable provider networks at scale.

Our vision is simple:One API. One provider ID. Frictionless provider data.

We’re backed by leading investors and built by a team with deep experience in provider data systems. At CertifyOS, we value authenticity, accountability, collaboration, results, and openness to feedback. We’re building a high-ownership team focused on solving real infrastructure problems that impact millions of patients.

About the role:

We are seeking a Senior Manager of Brand Marketing to own Certify's brand presence, content output, and audience-building channels end-to-end. This is a high-impact, creative-meets- strategic role for someone who can simultaneously build a cohesive brand identity and operatethe full content engine that brings it to life — from thought leadership to LinkedIn, events,podcasts, employer brand, and corporate communications.

You will help define how Certify shows up in the market — shaping perception among healthplan buyers, potential hires, and industry stakeholders. This role requires equal parts brandvision and content discipline. You will own the editorial calendar, manage all owned channels,and ensure every piece of content is consistent, compelling, and connected to businessobjectives.

What you'll do:

1. Brand Development & Identity

  • Steward Certify's brand identity — including voice, tone, visual language, and positioning ensuring consistency across all internal and external touchpoints.

  • Maintain and help evolve the living brand guidelines system — covering written style, design standards, messaging hierarchies, and channel-specific adaptations.

  • Lead periodic brand audits to evaluate consistency, resonance, and market perception, using findings to evolve the brand as Certify grows.

  • Partner with Product Marketing and leadership to ensure brand positioning is tightly integrated with Certify's market strategy and competitive narrative.

2. Content Strategy & Production

  • Own the master content strategy and editorial calendar, ensuring all content reinforces CertifyOS’ brand narrative, category POV, campaign priorities, and audience insights across channels.

  • Develop distinctive thought leadership that translates market trends, customer pain points, regulatory pressure, and product strategy into compelling content for health plan executives and provider operations leaders.

  • Lead the creation of high-quality content across articles, blogs, LinkedIn, newsletters, video scripts, webinars, event presentations, white papers, contributed industry pieces, and sales enablement assets.

  • Build a repeatable content production engine using AI tools, internal SMEs, customer insights, and external partners to scale output without sacrificing quality, originality, or editorial rigor.

  • Partner with Marketing, BD, Product, Customer Success, and the executive team to ensure content directly supports pipeline creation, customer education, product launches, events, and market authority.

3. Owned Channels: Podcast, LinkedIn & Newsletter

  • Own and operate Certify's podcast — from guest strategy and topic selection to production workflow, episode publishing, and audience growth.

  • Drive Certify's LinkedIn presence as a brand-building channel — developing a content cadence, growing follower engagement, and managing both company page and executive ghostwriting programs.

  • Build and grow Certify's owned newsletter — developing the editorial voice, subscriber growth strategy, and content rhythm that turns subscribers into advocates.

  • Track channel-level performance metrics and use data to continuously optimize content type, frequency, and distribution strategy.

4. Events & Sponsorships

  • Own Certify's events strategy — identifying, evaluating, and executing on industry conferences, roundtables, webinars, and proprietary events that build brand visibility and pipeline.

  • Manage event logistics end-to-end: booth presence, speaker submissions, session content, on-site materials, and post-event follow-up campaigns.

  • Build Certify's own event programming — from customer advisory board meetings to hosted industry roundtables — that positions Certify as a convener in the PDM space.

5. Employer Brand & Internal Communications

  • Develop and execute Certify's employer brand strategy — defining what it means to work at Certify and translating that into recruiting content, Glassdoor presence, careers page, and social storytelling.

  • Partner with People & Talent to build a talent marketing program that attracts mission- driven candidates who align with Certify's culture and values.

  • Own corporate communications — drafting executive announcements, company updates, investor communications, and press releases in Certify's voice.

  • Build internal brand engagement programs that reinforce culture and ensure employees are proud ambassadors of the Certify brand externally.

What Success Looks Like

  • Brand Consistency: A documented brand guidelines system live within 60 days; 100% of external content passing brand review within 90 days.

  • Content Velocity: Weekly content output across LinkedIn, blog, and newsletter sustained at scale; editorial calendar planned 4+ weeks ahead.

  • Podcast Growth: Podcast launched within 90 days; 10+ episodes published within 6 months with measurable audience growth quarter over quarter.

  • Channel Performance: LinkedIn follower growth ≥20% quarter over quarter; newsletter open rates above industry benchmark; event ROI tracked and reported.

  • Employer Brand: Certify employer brand presence established on LinkedIn and Glassdoor within 60 days; measurable improvement in qualified inbound applications.

What you'll need:

Must-Have Experience

  • 6–10+ years in brand marketing, content strategy, or editorial leadership — with a track record of building or transforming a brand at a healthcare or technology company.

  • Demonstrated experience owning content operations at scale — building editorial systems, managing production workflows, and maintaining quality across high-volume output.

  • Hands-on experience managing owned media channels: LinkedIn company presence, newsletters, podcasts, or video programs.

  • Strong writing and editorial skills — able to produce excellent content yourself and set the standard for others.

  • Proven ability to translate business goals into brand narratives and content strategies that resonate with B2B buyers and talent audiences alike.

Preferred Experience

  • Background in healthtech, health plan operations, or B2B enterprise SaaS with complex buyer audiences.

  • Experience with AI-driven content workflows — using tools like LLMs, automation platforms, or content intelligence software to scale output efficiently.

  • Experience managing or contributing to executive thought leadership programs and ghostwriting programs.

  • Familiarity with demand generation and ABM — understanding how brand content feeds pipeline and measuring brand's contribution to revenue.

Our Research & Culture Principles

  • Ground Truth First: No insight without validation. You talk to customers, prospects, and the market — you don’t just read reports.

  • Insight to Action: Research without a recommended action is incomplete. You close the loop between intelligence and business impact.

  • Low Ego, High Standards: Nothing is beneath you — you dive into the data, own the details, and hold yourself accountable to outcomes.

  • Prioritize Relentlessly: The market generates infinite signals. You know which ones matter and focus your energy accordingly.

  • Deliver A+ Work: “Good enough” is not our bar. The quality of your research reflects on Certify’s credibility with customers, investors, and partners.

Benefits of Working at Certify

  • At Certify, we’re building with intention and taking care of the people doing the work.

  • Your well-being matters to us. We provide 100% coverage of health, dental, and vision insurance premiums for employees. Our US-based team benefits from unlimited PTO, with at least two weeks off each year to recharge. In India, employees are supported with health insurance, statutory leave benefits, and additional wellness (menstrual) leave for women.

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to do their best work, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences.

If you require reasonable accommodations during the application process, please contact recruiting@certifyos.com.

We are also committed to pay transparency and foster an open culture where compensation conversations are encouraged and respected.
data.summary: CertifyOS is seeking a Senior Manager of Brand Marketing to own the company’s brand presence, content strategy, owned media channels, events, employer brand, and corporate communications. The role combines brand development, editorial leadership, thought leadership, podcast and LinkedIn management, event programming, and cross-functional collaboration to build market visibility, audience engagement, and pipeline support.
